## Why this study was run

**Research question:** [Can model responses provide useful ranking evidence?](../questions/response-evidence.qmd)

Test whether limiting response evidence volume repairs the response-retrieval baseline.

## Protocol and comparison

**Hypothesis:** A top-response normalization reduces volume bias and improves ranking.

Normalize response contribution while retaining the frozen evaluation scope.

## Decision and rationale
